summary: Experience Builder 1.21 is in the widget build matrix, and the local widget no longer freezes on that version.
details: 1.21 installs with pnpm 11.9.0 and Node 24. The downloadable build and the Docker image use that package manager when the extracted client declares it, and keep npm for 1.20 and older. A 1.21 extract ships an empty webpack override. Without the Audiom overlay, the widget compiles a missing program module and the builder retries until the tab freezes. Setup still copies the overlay. Restart the client after that copy; webpack --watch does not reload it. The install page lists 1.21 as the developer edition after Enterprise 12.1. Enterprise 12.2 uses Experience Builder 1.22, which is not packaged yet.
